title: Procedurally generated fish pet game
author: mbo4l88
selftext:
I built an iOS game with procedural generated fishpets that you can trade and breed with other fish to get unique creatures

[https://apps.apple.com/br/app/fishpet-a-quiet-reef/id6791711788](https://apps.apple.com/br/app/fishpet-a-quiet-reef/id6791711788)

comments.author: AlfishGames
comments.body: I’ve always had a soft spot for games about fishing. Are you planning to release it on Steam as well?

comments.author: Key-Soft-8248
comments.body: How did you make it a build for the app store ?

replies.author: mbo4l88
replies.body: Not sure I understand the question. This was built é specifically for AppStore, my goal was to create an iOS game, it was developed in swift

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: Ah ok so it was in Swift ? ( Sorry I just tried android and I used Unity because I was not sure how to " vibe code " a native mobile app for Android ) So I was curious how you did to use AI to code a native app ( but swift is only for Apple I think )

comments.author: Flyzank
comments.body: I love the idea bro, so cool

comments.author: SatisfactionLate3424
comments.body: I looove these fish! Love how they kept their unique fish features while looking straight-up cyberpunk. The black background makes it feel like some sci-fi documentary on weird alien wildlife lol.
